_comment: Static model registry for routing. Intelligence and coding index values were seeded once from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index / Coding Agent Index (Aug 2026) — treat them as settled; do not re-verify per task. Edit by hand when you deliberately update scores. Live signals (quota, load, observed tok/s) are merged by `bus models` at read time.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.intelligence_index_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Aug 2026 (max reasoning)
models.quota: claude plan; no local API — /usage in Claude Code TUI
models.notes: UI/design/artistic judgment and planning agents per orchestration preferences. AA Coding Index ~78.0, essentially tied with Sol. Opus 5.5 is NOT reachable through Paseo yet: on 2026-09-28 `paseo run --provider claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --thinking high` inspected as Model claude-opus-5 without an error, and `paseo provider models claude` lists no 5.5. Pin 5.5 here only after an inspected agent reports it.
